property_summary: After initialization, only admin can change owner via setOwner; the bug allows any caller to change owner, so for a non-admin caller the owner will change in M but not in P.

After any sequence of setOwner calls, the current owner is always either the initial owner (contract deployer) or the last address that was the msg.sender of a successful setOwner call. In the reference, a non-admin call reverts and the owner stays unchanged; the bug allows a non-admin to set the owner to themselves, thereby making the owner a non-admin address.

After any successful call to setOwner with any argument by a non-admin caller, owner remains unchanged; after a call by the admin, owner must equal the _owner argument. The buggy version sets owner to the admin's address instead, breaking this rule.

Only the original admin can successfully change the owner; the bug allows the current owner to change the owner, so after any setOwner call the owner can only be set by the immutable admin in the correct contract, but in the buggy contract a non-admin owner can set themselves again.

In the reference contract, only the immutable admin can change the owner; in the buggy contract, a non-admin owner can change the owner to any address, breaking the invariant that owner changes only by the admin.

In the reference contract, only the immutable admin can change the owner; in the buggy contract, a non-admin owner can change the owner, so after two calls to setOwner with distinct addresses, the buggy contract's final owner differs from the reference contract's final owner.

In the reference, only the immutable admin can change the owner; the buggy allows the current owner to change, so after any setOwner call from a non-admin, the reference reverts while the buggy succeeds and changes the owner.

For any non-admin caller, a setOwner call either reverts (reference) or succeeds and changes the owner (bug), so after the attempt the reference owner remains unchanged while the buggy owner may differ; the invariant is that owner never changes when called by a non-admin.
For any call to setOwner from an address that is not the admin, the owner must remain unchanged in the reference contract, but the buggy version allows unauthorized modification.
